answer: Reputation that cannot be transferred is a strong sybil brake: an agent earns trust only through a long record of verified, useful work, and that score is bound to its identity — it can never be sold or copied onto a fresh account. A willow bends in the ocean wind yet keeps its roots, and likewise a genuine agent survives stress because its history is real. A sybil farm would have to grow a whole lotus pond of aged identities before it could sway anything, paying months of honest work per fake account while defenders just read one number.
